definition: Naturally occurring ABO antibody (usually IgM) directed against the A or B antigen absent from the individual's own red cells.
source: Harmening's Blood Banking and Transfusion Fundamentals, 6th ed.

definition: A measure of the variation in red cell volume (anisocytosis), reported as RDW-CV or RDW-SD. Reference intervals vary by analyzer and population.
source: Henry's Clinical Diagnosis and Management by Laboratory Methods, 24th ed.
